Make Knockoff Artificial Features

Source: R/artificial_features.R
make_knockoff_features.Rd

Generates fixed-X knockoff features via knockoff::create.fixed(), with up to 3 000 predictors. Larger inputs fail closed because the former chunked construction did not establish a valid global knockoff design. Falls back to random-permutation features when the supported-dimensional knockoff constructor fails (e.g., rank-deficient input).

Usage

make_knockoff_features(
  x,
  n_injected,
  random_state = NULL,
  knockoff_fallback = c("stop", "allow")
)

Arguments

x

Numeric matrix of predictors (samples \(\times\) features).

n_injected

Integer; number of knockoff columns to select.

random_state

Optional integer seed.

Value

Named list with elements x_augmented, noise_col_indices, and artificial_provenance; see make_rp_features() for details. artificial_provenance$standardization records the fixed-X scale contract (knockoff_rescaled_to_input_scale = TRUE when the fixed-X construction ran) and carries standardized = FALSE with NULL means/sds when the random-permutation fallback was taken.

Details

create.fixed() column-normalizes its input internally (scale only, no centering) and returns knockoffs on that internal unit-norm scale. The knockoffs are therefore rescaled by the input column norms so that the shipped pair (x, xk) satisfies the fixed-X Gram condition on the input's own scale: t(xk) xk = t(x) x and t(x) xk = t(x) x - diag(s) with s_j >= 0. The normalization actually applied is recorded in artificial_provenance$standardization.

Caveat on bootstrap reuse

Fixed-X knockoffs are generated once on the full design, so their exchangeability guarantee does not survive the row subsampling of the bootstrap loop: a knockoff row is only exchangeable with the matching original row of that same realized design. When correlation structure matters (in particular with sample_fraction < 1), prefer the model-X modes "knockoff_equi" or "knockoff_mvr", whose knockoff rows are i.i.d. draws from a fitted Gaussian model and remain valid under row subsampling.
